biggest_catch: Dolly no longer exists as an independent platform — its helper app is now published by TaskRabbit Inc (package com.dolly.helpers) and applications go to taskrabbit.com/delivery/helpers.
catches: Dolly's Helper app is developed by TaskRabbit Inc — the brand has been folded into TaskRabbit.
No current official payout terms on the dolly.com domain for helpers; the only official pay figures are from a 2019 blog post.
Third-party sources disagree on the pay schedule (twice-weekly PayPal vs weekly).
TaskRabbit itself is already verified separately (R6713) — a separate Dolly route would double-count the same provider.

c1.evidence: Dolly helper app is published by TaskRabbit Inc; helper applications route to taskrabbit.com/delivery/helpers. Not an independent provider.

c2.evidence: No current official per-job payout terms on dolly.com.
